description: Gate R0.7 — minimal capability set for the Interest Growth Android runtime. Android never inherits the desktop surface: no window state, no desktop shell/window controls, no desktop filesystem breadth, no dialog save permissions, no updater, and no provider-secret administration. The remote broker and SAF operations are custom commands (remote_*, remote_pick_document, remote_api_upload_by_uri, remote_save_export) that do not require plugin capabilities, so the only plugin surface is opening external URLs in the system browser.
